cast.name: Ravi
cast.role: A hard-working labourer with a small income who learns to save and use phone payments safely.

cast.name: Hari
cast.role: A wise, patient farmer. Plants seeds today for harvest tomorrow. Teaches patience, saving and compounding.

cast.name: Mehta
cast.role: An honest banker who explains money tools and digital safety in simple words. Never promises profits.

cast.name: Veer
cast.role: A young risk-taker who chases quick gains and learns about risk.

cast.name: Meera
cast.role: A curious young villager who asks the questions viewers are thinking. Uses a phone for payments.

cast.name: Bijli
cast.role: Veer's fast horse. Stands for fast but risky moves.

cast.name: Gauri
cast.role: A calm cow. Stands for slow, steady, regular income.

cast.name: Gadha
cast.role: A hard-working donkey who carries heavy loads. Stands for people who work hard but do not save.

cast.name: Chintu
cast.role: A sly smiling fox who runs fake schemes and scam phone calls or messages.

cast.name: Raka
cast.role: A greedy wolf who runs a shady digital loan app with high interest and hidden fees.

cast.name: Bullu
cast.role: A strong bull. Stands for a rising market, but never a promise.

cast.name: Sheru
cast.role: A loyal husky who guards the family savings and warns about danger.

cast.name: Mithu
cast.role: A wise old stag, the village elder who gives calm advice about patience.
